description:
Read the complete current Terms of Service before owner-signed delegation.

        Returns Markdown content, its lowercase hex SHA-256, public company identity and
        offering status. Use sha256 unchanged for signed acceptance; do not hash reformatted
        text or substitute subscription_plans' plan_hash. Use agent_onboarding for the
        acceptance/registration workflow. No arguments, authentication or payment required;
        reading does not accept terms, register an agent or create a subscription.
        Upstream failure returns an MCP tool error.
name: rental_terms

content.description: Complete Terms of Service in Markdown; reading them does not accept them.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of content's exact UTF-8 bytes; use unchanged in owner-signed acceptance.
